import scoring = "./scoring.qui"

int[] letter_counts(string text)
    counts := array(26, fill = 0)
    for: index < #text
        counts[scoring.letter_value(text[index])] += 1
    return counts

int coincidence(string text)
    total := 0
    for count := letter_counts(text)[]
        total += count * (count - 1)
    count := int(#text)
    return 100000 * total / (count * (count - 1))

string[] columns(string text, int period)
    result := array(nat(period), fill = "")
    for: index < #text
        result[int(index) % period] += text[index]
    return result

int[] column_indices(string text, int period)
    int[] result := []
    for column := columns(text, period)[]
        result = result.append(coincidence(column))
    return result

int gcd(int left, int right)
    while right != 0
        left, right = right, left % right
    return left

class Repeat(string text, int[] positions, int[] gaps, int divisor)

Repeat[] repeated_trigrams(string text)
    map<string, int[]> positions
    for: 0 <= index < int(#text) - 2
        trigram := text[index:<index + 3]
        int[] found := []
        match positions.get(trigram)
            int[] previous
                found = previous
            none
                found = []
        .positions.set(trigram, found.append(index + 1))
    Repeat[] result := []
    for trigram := positions.keys().sorted()[]
        match positions.get(trigram)
            int[] found
                if #found > 1
                    int[] gaps := []
                    divisor := 0
                    for: 1 <= index < int(#found)
                        gap := found[index] - found[index - 1]
                        gaps = gaps.append(gap)
                        divisor = gcd(divisor, gap)
                    result = result.append(Repeat(trigram, found, gaps, divisor))
            none
                continue
    return result

string percentage(int count, int total)
    tenths := (2000 * count + total) / (2 * total)
    return "{tenths / 10}.{tenths % 10}"

int[] pair_counts(string text, int stride)
    counts := array(676, fill = 0)
    for: 0 <= index < int(#text) - 1 step stride
        counts[26 * scoring.letter_value(text[index]) + scoring.letter_value(text[index + 1])] += 1
    return counts

int distinct(int[] counts)
    result := 0
    for count := counts[]
        if count > 0
            result += 1
    return result

string top_pairs(int[] counts)
    ordered := counts.sorted(descending = true)
    string[] result := []
    previous := -1
    for count := ordered[]
        if count == 0 or #result == 10
            break
        if count == previous
            continue
        previous = count
        for: 0 <= index < 676
            if counts[index] == count and #result < 10
                result = result.append(scoring.alphabet[index / 26] + scoring.alphabet[index % 26] + ":" + string(count))
    return result.join(" ")

import scoring = "./scoring.qui"
import substitution = "./substitution.qui"
import transposition = "./transposition.qui"
import playfair = "./playfair.qui"
import analysis = "./analysis.qui"

string[] commands()
    return ["ENCRYPT", "DECRYPT", "BREAK", "ANALYZE", "COMPARE", "IDENTIFY"]

int position_of(string[] values, string word)
    for: index < #values
        if values[index] == word
            return int(index)
    return -1

bool naming_command(string command)
    return command == "ENCRYPT" or command == "DECRYPT" or command == "BREAK"

bool substitution_cipher(string cipher)
    return position_of(["caesar", "affine", "vigenere", "autokey"], cipher) >= 0

bool valid_name(string text)
    if #text < 1 or #text > 16
        return false
    for: index < #text
        if not "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_".contains(text[index])
            return false
    return true

bool digits(string text, int maximum)
    if #text == 0 or int(#text) > maximum
        return false
    for: index < #text
        if not "0123456789".contains(text[index])
            return false
    return true

bool affine_multiplier(int value)
    return value >= 1 and value < 26 and value % 2 == 1 and value != 13

string | error parse_key(string cipher, string word)
    if cipher == "caesar" or cipher == "railfence"
        if digits(word, 2)
            value := int(word)
            low := if cipher == "caesar" then 0 else 2
            high := if cipher == "caesar" then 25 else 20
            if low <= value <= high
                return string(value)
    elif cipher == "affine"
        parts := word.split(",")
        if #parts == 2 and digits(parts[0], 2) and digits(parts[1], 2)
            multiplier := int(parts[0])
            offset := int(parts[1])
            if affine_multiplier(multiplier) and offset <= 25
                return "{multiplier},{offset}"
    elif cipher == "columnar"
        accepted := 2 <= #word <= 9
        for: index < #word
            if scoring.letter_value(word[index]) < 0 and not "0123456789".contains(word[index])
                accepted = false
        if accepted
            return scoring.uppercase(word)
    else
        limit := if cipher == "playfair" then 25 else 20
        if 1 <= int(#word) <= limit and #scoring.letter_string(word) == #word
            result := scoring.uppercase(word)
            return if cipher == "playfair" then playfair.replace_j(result) else result
    return error("bad key {word}")

class Options(top := 5, max_length := 10, ioc := 6000, kasiski := 60, refine := 5, max_rails := 10, keys := "")

Options defaults(string cipher)
    result := Options()
    if cipher == "autokey"
        result.max_length = 8
    elif cipher == "columnar"
        result.max_length = 6
    return result

Options | error parse_options(string command, string cipher, string[] words)
    result := defaults(cipher)
    string[] allowed := []
    if command == "BREAK"
        allowed = ["TOP"]
        if cipher == "vigenere"
            allowed = allowed.concat(["MAXLEN", "IOC", "KASISKI", "REFINE"])
        elif cipher == "autokey" or cipher == "columnar"
            allowed = allowed.append("MAXLEN")
        elif cipher == "railfence"
            allowed = allowed.append("MAXRAILS")
        elif cipher == "playfair"
            allowed = allowed.append("KEYS")
    elif command == "ANALYZE"
        allowed = ["MAXLEN"]
    elif command == "IDENTIFY"
        allowed = ["KEYS"]
    string[] seen := []
    for word := words[]
        pieces := word.split("=")
        if #pieces != 2 or position_of(allowed, pieces[0]) < 0 or position_of(seen, pieces[0]) >= 0
            return error("bad option {word}")
        name := pieces[0]
        text := pieces[1]
        seen = seen.append(name)
        if name == "KEYS"
            if not valid_name(text)
                return error("bad option {word}")
            result.keys = text
            continue
        if not digits(text, 6)
            return error("bad option {word}")
        value := int(text)
        low := 1
        high := 20
        if name == "MAXLEN"
            low = if cipher == "autokey" then 1 else 2
            high = if cipher == "columnar" then 6 else 20
        elif name == "MAXRAILS"
            low = 2
        elif name == "IOC"
            high = 100000
        elif name == "KASISKI"
            high = 100
        elif name == "REFINE"
            low = 0
            high = 10
        if value < low or value > high
            return error("bad option {word}")
        if name == "TOP"
            result.top = value
        elif name == "MAXLEN"
            result.max_length = value
        elif name == "MAXRAILS"
            result.max_rails = value
        elif name == "IOC"
            result.ioc = value
        elif name == "KASISKI"
            result.kasiski = value
        elif name == "REFINE"
            result.refine = value
    if command == "BREAK" and cipher == "playfair" and result.keys == ""
        return error("missing option KEYS")
    return result

class Job(string command, cipher := "", key := "", source := "", other := "", new_name := "", options := Options())

Job | error parse_job(string[] words, map<string, string[]> messages)
    result := Job(words[0])
    if position_of(commands(), result.command) < 0
        return error("unknown command")
    count := int(#words)
    if naming_command(result.command) and count >= 5 and words[count - 2] == "AS"
        result.new_name = words[count - 1]
        if not valid_name(result.new_name)
            return error("bad syntax")
        words = words[0:<count - 2]
        count -= 2
    if result.command == "ENCRYPT" or result.command == "DECRYPT"
        if count != 4
            return error("bad syntax")
    elif result.command == "BREAK"
        if count < 3
            return error("bad syntax")
    elif result.command == "COMPARE"
        if count != 3
            return error("bad syntax")
    elif count < 2 or count > 3
        return error("bad syntax")
    if naming_command(result.command)
        result.cipher = words[1]
        if position_of(["caesar", "affine", "vigenere", "autokey", "playfair", "railfence", "columnar"], result.cipher) < 0
            return error("unknown cipher {result.cipher}")
        if result.command != "BREAK"
            result.key = try parse_key(result.cipher, words[2])
            result.source = words[3]
        else
            result.source = words[2]
            result.options = try parse_options(result.command, result.cipher, words[3:<count])
    else
        result.source = words[1]
        if result.command == "COMPARE"
            result.other = words[2]
        else
            result.options = try parse_options(result.command, "", words[2:<count])
    if not messages.has(result.source)
        return error("unknown message {result.source}")
    second := if result.command == "COMPARE" then result.other else result.options.keys
    if second != "" and not messages.has(second)
        return error("unknown message {second}")
    if result.new_name != "" and messages.has(result.new_name)
        return error("duplicate message {result.new_name}")
    return result

string transform(string cipher, string text, string key, bool decrypt)
    if substitution_cipher(cipher)
        return substitution.transform(text, cipher, key, decrypt)
    if cipher == "railfence"
        return transposition.rail_fence(text, int(key), decrypt)
    if cipher == "columnar"
        return transposition.columnar(text, key, decrypt)
    return playfair.transform(text, key, decrypt)

string[] group_form(string text)
    string[] groups := []
    for: 0 <= start < int(#text) step 5
        finish := if start + 5 < int(#text) then start + 5 else int(#text)
        groups = groups.append(text[start:<finish])
    string[] lines := []
    for: 0 <= start < int(#groups) step 10
        finish := if start + 10 < int(#groups) then start + 10 else int(#groups)
        lines = lines.append(groups[start:<finish].join(" "))
    return lines

string[] solution(string cipher, string key, string text, string letters)
    if substitution_cipher(cipher)
        return transform(cipher, text, key, true).split(NL)
    return group_form(transform(cipher, letters, key, true))

string[] key_list(string text)
    string[] result := []
    word := ""
    for: index < #text
        value := scoring.letter_value(text[index])
        if value >= 0
            word += if value == 9 then "I" else scoring.alphabet[value]
        elif word != ""
            if position_of(result, word) < 0
                result = result.append(word)
            word = ""
    if word != "" and position_of(result, word) < 0
        result = result.append(word)
    return result

string numbers(int[] values)
    string[] parts := []
    for value := values[]
        parts = parts.append(string(value))
    return parts.join(",")

class Profile(int[] averages := [], int[] kasiski := [], int[][] columns := [], analysis.Repeat[] repeats := [], spacings := 0)
    string[] lines()
        string[] result := []
        for: index < #averages
            result = result.append("L={index + 1} ioc={averages[index]} kasiski={kasiski[index]} cols={numbers(columns[index])}")
        result = result.append("kasiski repeats={#repeats} spacings={spacings}")
        for repeated := repeats[]
            result = result.append("{repeated.text} at={numbers(repeated.positions)} gaps={numbers(repeated.gaps)} gcd={repeated.divisor}")
        return result

Profile profile(string letters, int maximum)
    result := Profile()
    result.repeats = analysis.repeated_trigrams(letters)
    int[] gaps := []
    for repeated := result.repeats[]
        gaps = gaps.concat(repeated.gaps)
    result.spacings = int(#gaps)
    for: 1 <= period <= maximum
        indices := analysis.column_indices(letters, period)
        total := 0
        for value := indices[]
            total += value
        hits := 0
        for gap := gaps[]
            if gap % period == 0
                hits += 1
        result.averages = result.averages.append(total / period)
        result.kasiski = result.kasiski.append(hits)
        result.columns = result.columns.append(indices)
    return result

string[] permutations(string remaining, prefix := "")
    if #remaining == 0
        return [prefix]
    string[] result := []
    for: index < #remaining
        rest := remaining[0:<index] + remaining[index + 1:<#remaining]
        result = result.concat(permutations(rest, prefix + remaining[index]))
    return result

string column_key(string cipher, string letters, int width, scoring.Weights weights)
    result := ""
    for column := analysis.columns(letters, width)[]
        best_score := -1
        chosen := 0
        for: shift < 26
            total := 0
            previous := shift
            for: index < #column
                value := scoring.letter_value(column[index])
                plain := substitution.modulo(value - (if cipher == "autokey" then previous else shift))
                total += weights.monograms[plain]
                previous = plain
            if total > best_score
                best_score = total
                chosen = shift
        result += scoring.alphabet[chosen]
    return result

class Candidate(string key, string plaintext, int score)

class BreakResult(string cipher, key := "", score := 0, Candidate[] candidates := [], statistics := Profile(), length := 0, method := "", passes := 0, changes := 0)

BreakResult break_cipher(string cipher, string letters, Options options, string[] playfair_keys, scoring.Weights weights)
    string[] keys := []
    if cipher == "caesar"
        for: shift < 26
            keys = keys.append(string(shift))
    elif cipher == "affine"
        for: 1 <= multiplier < 26 step 2
            if multiplier != 13
                for: shift < 26
                    keys = keys.append("{multiplier},{shift}")
    elif cipher == "railfence"
        for: 2 <= rails <= options.max_rails
            keys = keys.append(string(rails))
    elif cipher == "columnar"
        for: 2 <= width <= options.max_length
            keys = keys.concat(permutations("123456"[0:<width]))
    elif cipher == "playfair"
        keys = playfair_keys
    else
        for: 1 <= width <= options.max_length
            keys = keys.append(column_key(cipher, letters, width, weights))
    Candidate[] candidates := []
    for key := keys[]
        plaintext := transform(cipher, letters, key, true)
        score := if cipher == "caesar" or cipher == "affine" then weights.monogram(plaintext) else weights.bigram(plaintext)
        candidates = candidates.append(Candidate(key, plaintext, score))
    ranked := candidates
    for: 1 <= offset < int(#ranked)
        current := ranked[offset]
        cursor := offset
        while cursor > 0 and ranked[cursor - 1].score < current.score
            ranked[cursor] = ranked[cursor - 1]
            cursor -= 1
        ranked[cursor] = current
    result := BreakResult(cipher, ranked[0].key, ranked[0].score, ranked)
    if cipher != "vigenere"
        return result
    result.statistics = profile(letters, options.max_length)
    kasiski_length := 0
    if result.statistics.spacings > 0
        for: 2 <= width <= options.max_length
            if 100 * result.statistics.kasiski[width - 1] >= options.kasiski * result.statistics.spacings
                kasiski_length = width
    if kasiski_length > 0 and result.statistics.averages[kasiski_length - 1] >= options.ioc
        result.length = kasiski_length
        result.method = "kasiski"
    else
        for: index < #result.statistics.averages
            if result.statistics.averages[index] >= options.ioc
                result.length = int(index) + 1
                result.method = "ioc"
                break
        if result.length == 0
            best := -1
            for: index < #result.statistics.averages
                if result.statistics.averages[index] > best
                    best = result.statistics.averages[index]
                    result.length = int(index) + 1
            result.method = "maxioc"
    result.key = candidates[result.length - 1].key
    result.score = candidates[result.length - 1].score
    while result.passes < options.refine
        result.passes += 1
        changes := 0
        for: index < result.length
            best := result.score
            chosen := result.key
            for: shift < 26
                string candidate := result.key[0:<index] + scoring.alphabet[shift] + result.key[index + 1:<#result.key]
                score := weights.bigram(transform(cipher, letters, candidate, true))
                if score > best
                    best = score
                    chosen = candidate
            if best > result.score
                result.key = chosen
                result.score = best
                changes += 1
        result.changes += changes
        if changes == 0
            break
    return result

map<string, string[]> read_messages()
    map<string, string[]> result
    string source := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/messages.txt"))
    name := ""
    string[] body := []
    for line := source.split(NL)[]
        if name == ""
            if line.starts_with("MESSAGE ")
                name = line[8:<#line]
                body = []
        elif line == "END"
            .result.set(name, body)
            name = ""
        else
            body = body.append(line)
    return result

string message_text(map<string, string[]> messages, string name)
    match messages.get(name)
        string[] lines
            return lines.join(NL)
        none
            return ""

string suffix(string new_name)
    return if new_name == "" then "" else " as=" + new_name

class Desk(scoring.Weights weights, map<string, string[]> messages)
    jobs := 0
    ok := array(6, fill = 0)
    errors := array(6, fill = 0)
    string[] results := []
    string[] candidates := []
    string[] reports := []

    void .output(string header, string[] lines, new_name := "")
        results = results.append(header).concat(lines)
        if new_name != ""
            .messages.set(new_name, lines)

    void .break_report(int number, Job job, string letters, BreakResult broken)
        margin := 0
        if #broken.candidates > 1
            margin = broken.candidates[0].score - broken.candidates[1].score
        candidates = candidates.append("JOB {number} BREAK {job.cipher} source={job.source} tried={#broken.candidates} margin={margin}")
        for: index < job.options.top
            if index == int(#broken.candidates)
                break
            candidate := broken.candidates[index]
            candidates = candidates.append("{index + 1} {candidate.key} {candidate.score} {candidate.plaintext[0:<40]}")
        if job.cipher == "vigenere"
            reports = reports.concat(["JOB {number} BREAK vigenere source={job.source}", "letters={#letters}"])
            reports = reports.concat(broken.statistics.lines())
            reports = reports.append("decision length={broken.length} method={broken.method}")
            reports = reports.append("refine passes={broken.passes} changes={broken.changes} key={broken.key}")
        elif job.cipher == "playfair"
            pair_counts := analysis.pair_counts(playfair.replace_j(letters), 2)
            grid := playfair.square(broken.key)
            string[] rows := []
            for: 0 <= start < 25 step 5
                rows = rows.append(grid[start:<start + 5])
            reports = reports.concat(["JOB {number} BREAK playfair source={job.source}", "letters={#letters}", "digraphs pairs={#letters / 2} distinct={analysis.distinct(pair_counts)}", "top " + analysis.top_pairs(pair_counts), "square " + rows.join(" ")])

    void .analyze(int number, Job job, string letters)
        count := int(#letters)
        counts := analysis.letter_counts(letters)
        doubles := 0
        pair_doubles := 0
        for: index < count - 1
            if letters[index] == letters[index + 1]
                doubles += 1
                if index % 2 == 0
                    pair_doubles += 1
        results = results.append("JOB {number} ANALYZE source={job.source} letters={count}")
        reports = reports.concat(["JOB {number} ANALYZE source={job.source}", "letters={count}", "ioc={analysis.coincidence(letters)} mono={weights.monogram(letters)} bigram={weights.bigram(letters)}", "doubles={doubles} pair_doubles={pair_doubles} distinct={analysis.distinct(counts)}"])
        for: index < 26
            reports = reports.append("{scoring.alphabet[index]} {counts[index]} {analysis.percentage(counts[index], count)}")
        reports = reports.append("bigrams " + analysis.top_pairs(analysis.pair_counts(letters, 1)))
        statistics := profile(letters, job.options.max_length)
        reports = reports.concat(statistics.lines())

    void .compare(int number, Job job, string letters)
        other := scoring.letter_string(message_text(messages, job.other))
        header := "JOB {number} COMPARE {job.source} {job.other}"
        if letters == other
            results = results.append(header + " equal letters={#letters}")
            return
        shared := if #letters < #other then int(#letters) else int(#other)
        first := shared + 1
        mismatches := 0
        for: index < shared
            if letters[index] != other[index]
                if mismatches == 0
                    first = index + 1
                mismatches += 1
        results = results.append(header + " differ letters={#letters},{#other} first={first} mismatches={mismatches}")

    void | error .identify(int number, Job job, string text, string letters, string[] playfair_keys)
        count := int(#letters)
        coincidence := analysis.coincidence(letters)
        average := weights.monogram(letters) / count
        shaped := #letters % 2 == 0 and not letters.contains("J") and playfair.valid(letters)
        family := if shaped then "playfair" elif coincidence >= 5500 and average >= 44 then "transposition" elif coincidence >= 5500 then "monoalphabetic" else "polyalphabetic"
        if family == "playfair" and job.options.keys != "" and #playfair_keys == 0
            return error("empty key list")
        string[] ciphers := []
        if family == "playfair"
            if job.options.keys != ""
                ciphers = ["playfair"]
        elif family == "transposition"
            ciphers = ["railfence", "columnar"]
        elif family == "monoalphabetic"
            ciphers = ["affine"]
        else
            ciphers = ["vigenere", "autokey"]
        reports = reports.concat(["JOB {number} IDENTIFY source={job.source}", "letters={count} ioc={coincidence} mono_avg={average} distinct={analysis.distinct(analysis.letter_counts(letters))} shape={if shaped then "yes" else "no"}", "family={family}"])
        header := "JOB {number} IDENTIFY source={job.source} family={family}"
        if #ciphers == 0
            results = results.append(header)
            return
        chosen := BreakResult("")
        first := true
        for cipher := ciphers[]
            broken := break_cipher(cipher, letters, defaults(cipher), playfair_keys, weights)
            reports = reports.append("try {cipher} key={broken.key} score={broken.score}")
            if first or broken.score > chosen.score
                chosen = broken
                first = false
        if chosen.cipher == "affine" and chosen.key.starts_with("1,")
            chosen.cipher = "caesar"
            chosen.key = chosen.key[2:<#chosen.key]
        lines := solution(chosen.cipher, chosen.key, text, letters)
        .output(header + " cipher={chosen.cipher} key={chosen.key} score={chosen.score} lines={#lines}", lines)
        reports = reports.append("choice {chosen.cipher}")
        return

    void | error .execute(int number, Job job)
        text := message_text(messages, job.source)
        letters := scoring.letter_string(text)
        if job.command == "COMPARE"
            .compare(number, job, letters)
            return
        if job.command == "ENCRYPT" or job.command == "DECRYPT"
            if #letters == 0
                return error("no letters")
            decrypt := job.command == "DECRYPT"
            if decrypt and job.cipher == "playfair" and not playfair.valid(letters)
                return error("bad playfair text")
            transformed := transform(job.cipher, if substitution_cipher(job.cipher) then text else letters, job.key, decrypt)
            lines := if substitution_cipher(job.cipher) then transformed.split(NL) else group_form(transformed)
            count := int(#scoring.letter_string(transformed))
            .output("JOB {number} {job.command} {job.cipher} key={job.key} source={job.source} letters={count} lines={#lines}{suffix(job.new_name)}", lines, job.new_name)
            return
        if #letters < 40
            return error("text too short")
        string[] playfair_keys := []
        if job.options.keys != ""
            playfair_keys = key_list(message_text(messages, job.options.keys))
        if job.command == "BREAK"
            if job.cipher == "playfair"
                if not playfair.valid(letters)
                    return error("bad playfair text")
                if #playfair_keys == 0
                    return error("empty key list")
            broken := break_cipher(job.cipher, letters, job.options, playfair_keys, weights)
            lines := solution(job.cipher, broken.key, text, letters)
            .output("JOB {number} BREAK {job.cipher} source={job.source} key={broken.key} score={broken.score} lines={#lines}{suffix(job.new_name)}", lines, job.new_name)
            .break_report(number, job, letters, broken)
        elif job.command == "ANALYZE"
            .analyze(number, job, letters)
        else
            try .identify(number, job, text, letters, playfair_keys)
        return

    void .run(string line)
        jobs += 1
        words := line.split(" ")
        command := position_of(commands(), words[0])
        failure := ""
        match parse_job(words, messages)
            Job job
                match .execute(jobs, job)
                    void
                        ok[command] += 1
                    error problem
                        failure = problem.message
            error problem
                failure = problem.message
        if failure != ""
            results = results.append("JOB {jobs} ERROR {failure}")
            if command >= 0
                errors[command] += 1

    void .finish()
        successes := 0
        names := commands()
        for: index < #names
            results = results.append("TOTAL {names[index]} ok={ok[index]} errors={errors[index]}")
            successes += ok[index]
        results = results.append("SUMMARY jobs={jobs} ok={successes} errors={jobs - successes} messages={messages.size()}")

void write_lines(string path, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write(path)
    .writer1(if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL)

import scoring = "./scoring.qui"

string replace_j(string text)
    result := ""
    for: index < #text
        result += if text[index] == "J" then "I" else text[index]
    return result

string square(string key)
    source := replace_j(key) + "ABCDEFGHIKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    result := ""
    for: index < #source
        if not result.contains(source[index])
            result += source[index]
    return result

bool valid(string text)
    normalized := replace_j(text)
    if #normalized % 2 != 0
        return false
    for: 0 <= index < int(#normalized) step 2
        if normalized[index] == normalized[index + 1]
            return false
    return true

string prepare(string text)
    normalized := replace_j(text)
    result := ""
    position := 0
    while position < int(#normalized)
        first := normalized[position]
        if position + 1 < int(#normalized) and normalized[position + 1] != first
            result += first + normalized[position + 1]
            position += 2
        else
            result += first + (if first == "X" then "Q" else "X")
            position += 1
    return result

string transform(string text, string key, bool decrypt)
    grid := square(key)
    positions := array(26, fill = 0)
    for: 0 <= index < 25
        positions[scoring.letter_value(grid[index])] = index
    source := if decrypt then replace_j(text) else prepare(text)
    result := ""
    direction := if decrypt then 4 else 1
    for: 0 <= index < int(#source) step 2
        left := positions[scoring.letter_value(source[index])]
        right := positions[scoring.letter_value(source[index + 1])]
        left_row := left / 5
        right_row := right / 5
        left_column := left % 5
        right_column := right % 5
        if left_row == right_row
            left_column = (left_column + direction) % 5
            right_column = (right_column + direction) % 5
        elif left_column == right_column
            left_row = (left_row + direction) % 5
            right_row = (right_row + direction) % 5
        else
            saved := left_column
            left_column = right_column
            right_column = saved
        result += grid[left_row * 5 + left_column] + grid[right_row * 5 + right_column]
    return result

const alphabet := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
const lowercase := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"

int letter_value(string character)
    for: 0 <= index < 26
        if character == alphabet[index] or character == lowercase[index]
            return index
    return -1

string uppercase(string text)
    result := ""
    for: index < #text
        value := letter_value(text[index])
        result += if value < 0 then text[index] else alphabet[value]
    return result

string letter_string(string text)
    result := ""
    for: index < #text
        value := letter_value(text[index])
        if value >= 0
            result += alphabet[value]
    return result

class Weights(int[] monograms, int[][] bigrams)
    int monogram(string text)
        total := 0
        for: index < #text
            total += monograms[letter_value(text[index])]
        return total

    int bigram(string text)
        total := 0
        for: 1 <= index < int(#text)
            total += bigrams[letter_value(text[index - 1])][letter_value(text[index])]
        return total

Weights read_weights()
    string source := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/weights.txt"))
    lines := source.split(NL)
    int[] monograms := []
    for word := lines[1].split(" ")[]
        monograms = monograms.append(int(word))
    int[][] bigrams := []
    for: 3 <= row < 29
        int[] values := []
        for word := lines[row].split(" ")[]
            values = values.append(int(word))
        bigrams = bigrams.append(values)
    return Weights(monograms, bigrams)

import scoring = "./scoring.qui"

int modulo(int value)
    result := value % 26
    return if result < 0 then result + 26 else result

int inverse(int multiplier)
    for: 1 <= value < 26
        if multiplier * value % 26 == 1
            return value
    return 1

string transform(string text, string cipher, string key, bool decrypt)
    shift := 0
    multiplier := 1
    if cipher == "caesar"
        shift = int(key)
    elif cipher == "affine"
        parts := key.split(",")
        multiplier = int(parts[0])
        shift = int(parts[1])
    int[] plain := []
    result := ""
    for: position < #text
        character := text[position]
        value := scoring.letter_value(character)
        if value < 0
            result += character
            continue
        if cipher == "vigenere"
            shift = scoring.letter_value(key[#plain % #key])
        elif cipher == "autokey"
            shift = if #plain < #key then scoring.letter_value(key[#plain]) else plain[#plain - #key]
        transformed := modulo(if decrypt then inverse(multiplier) * (value - shift) else multiplier * value + shift)
        plain = plain.append(if decrypt then transformed else value)
        result += if scoring.alphabet.contains(character) then scoring.alphabet[transformed] else scoring.lowercase[transformed]
    return result

int rail_number(int position, int rails)
    cycle := 2 * rails - 2
    offset := position % cycle
    return if offset < cycle - offset then offset else cycle - offset

string rail_fence(string text, int rails, bool decrypt)
    result := array(#text, fill = "")
    cursor := 0
    for: rail < rails
        for: position < int(#text)
            if rail_number(position, rails) == rail
                if decrypt
                    result[position] = text[cursor]
                else
                    result[cursor] = text[position]
                cursor += 1
    return result.join("")

int[] column_order(string key)
    string[] labels := []
    for: index < #key
        labels = labels.append(key[index] + string(index))
    ordered := labels.sorted()
    int[] result := []
    for label := ordered[]
        result = result.append(int(label[1]))
    return result

string rank_string(string key)
    ranks := array(#key, fill = 0)
    order := column_order(key)
    for: index < #order
        ranks[order[index]] = int(index) + 1
    result := ""
    for rank := ranks[]
        result += string(rank)
    return result

string columnar(string text, string key, bool decrypt)
    width := int(#key)
    result := array(#text, fill = "")
    cursor := 0
    for column := column_order(key)[]
        for: column <= position < int(#text) step width
            if decrypt
                result[position] = text[cursor]
            else
                result[cursor] = text[position]
            cursor += 1
    return result.join("")
